candidates.reason: Exercises _ScrapyClientContextFactory, its OpenSSL context construction, and real HTTPS requests, making it the most direct place to verify SSLKEYLOGFILE parsing and output.
Shared HTTPS downloader suite can assert end-to-end key logging for successful TLS requests while being reused by the built-in handlers.
Concrete Twisted HTTP/1.1 HTTPS test classes instantiate the shared TLS scenarios and would catch handler-specific context wiring.
Concrete Twisted HTTP/2 HTTPS tests verify that key logging also reaches contexts used by the H2 download handler.
